name: DS Cluster S33: Fundamental Fill (Quarterly to Daily via ffill)
description: Tests: ffill for quarterly earnings to daily, PE ratio construction from sparse EPS, is_valid for observation detection, where for sparse metric gating.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S33: Fundamental Fill
# Tests: ffill for quarterly→daily, PE ratio, sparse fundamental data
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === QUARTERLY EARNINGS → DAILY ===
inc = income_statement(period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)()
eps_raw = inc.basic_eps
revenue_raw = inc.revenue

# ffill: carry quarterly value forward until next report
eps = ffill(eps_raw)
revenue = ffill(revenue_raw)

# === PE RATIO from sparse EPS ===
# Annualize quarterly EPS (multiply by 4)
annual_eps = eps * 4
pe_ratio = where(annual_eps > 0, close / annual_eps)

# === OBSERVATION DETECTION ===
had_earnings = is_valid(eps_raw)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='EPS (ffilled from quarterly)',
    category='Fundamental Fill',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EPS (annualized)', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=annual_eps)

xy_lines(
    title='Trailing PE Ratio',
    category='Fundamental Fill',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='PE', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=pe_ratio)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.FileTextIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='EPS', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Earnings Report'
    )
)((eps_raw, had_earnings))
